title: 7AA.2 partial DXF MLEADER arrowhead-index preservation
scope: Separate DXF group-94 arrowhead index from the DWG legacy default bit
Preserve the exact DXF index and associated handle through AC1021 ASCII/Binary output
Refuse conversions for which the local data model lacks an exact mapping

implementation.summary: ArrowHeadEntry now carries an int32 DXF index and explicit presence bit separately from isDefault. DXF parsing retains the integer without Boolean coercion. The AC1021 writer emits the stored code-94 index and associated remapped code-345 handle. It fails before entity publication if an entry lacks a DXF index or the target is newer than AC1021, because current DWG default flags and modern targets do not have an evidenced mapping in this model.
implementation.limitations: Does not resolve DWG default-bit-to-DXF-index semantics, provide an independent producer witness, establish modern DXF arrowhead-array representation, or claim general MLEADER support.
